summary: Security audit validation: magic-link single-use, 2FA enforced on password login, and non-regression of the Thomas guest login button. All 3 backend pytest cases PASS and frontend Thomas flow PASS with StrictMode + single-use link (no ?error=link_failed, cockpit reached, 'Bonsoir Thomas' visible, rebrand 'MyExtension AI' visible).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend email validator (pydantic EmailStr) rejects .local TLD — the request asked to use audit2fa@test.local but this is refused with 422. Tests were adapted to use @example.com. If the app must support .local emails for internal audits, add email_validator with allow_special_chars/domains or a permissive validator.

auth/me fetch from page.evaluate returned 403 because the frontend likely stores token in-memory or httpOnly cookie not readable by cross-fetch — this is fine (UI works) but confirms token is not in localStorage; ensure this is intentional.
test_credentials: thomas@zayado.fr (magic-link guest button); audit2fa@example.com / MotDePasse123 (2FA enabled)
seed_data_creation: Created user audit2fa@example.com with 2FA enabled in /app/backend/zayado.db (originally requested email @test.local was rejected by backend email validation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refuses .local email TLD in EmailStr — use @example.com. The audit2fa@example.com user has 2FA enabled; to disable, login via /login (needs 2FA code from DB users.settings.pending_2fa_code), then POST /api/auth/2fa/toggle.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Magic-link single-use returns 401 with 'Ce lien a déjà été utilisé.' on 2nd use. 2FA login returns {requires_2fa:true, challenge_token:...} without access_token; /auth/login/verify-2fa validates the 6-digit code and issues access_token; bad code returns 400 'Code invalide'. Users without 2FA still get direct access_token.
